headline: Public hearings on six requests for permits and variances, including repair shops, a kennel, and a two-family home.
summary: Requests include a repair shop at 48 Culley St. and another at 59 Sheldon St. Other cases cover a kennel at 78 River St., a five-unit apartment appeal at 13-15 Chestnut St., and a two-family home at 38-44 Granite St.
items: Special permit to reinstate a former Group Home at 28 Heywood St.
Special permit for a motor vehicle repair and body shop at 48 Culley St.
Special permit for a motor vehicle repair facility at 59 Sheldon St.
Change to an existing special permit for a dog kennel at 78 River St.
Appeal of a building commissioner decision on five apartments at 13-15 Chestnut St.
Variance for a two-family home at 38-44 Granite St.

ZBA-24-34                             Carlos Martins                      28 HEYWOOD ST.            6:00PM

to six dogs in connection with the existing dog-training operation. Located in the Industrial I 
District Map 28 Block 4 Lot 0  
 
ZBA-26-23                             Joseph Smeraldi                      13-15 CHESTNUT ST.         7:15 PM 
Appeal to overrule the Building Commissioner’s September 14 th determination under §181.92 to 
administratively reinstate the abandoned preexisting nonconforming multi-family residential use 
for five dwelling units, pursuant to Section 181.3362(B) of the Fitchburg Zoning Ordinance. Said 
appeal being submitted under the provisions of §181.9223 and M.G.L. c. 40A §§8 and 15.  Located 
in the Residential B District Map 18 Block 107 Lot 0  
 
ZBA-26-25                             Christopher Anderson  38-44 Granite St.                 7:45 PM 
Dimensional variance under §181.93 of the Fitchburg Zoning Ordinance to allow the construction 
of a two-family structure with dimensional relief relative to lot area (reducing from 7500 SF 
minimum to the existing 6418 SF), front yard setback (from the minimum 20 feet to 8 feet) and
2  
rear yard setback (from the minimum 20 feet to 6 feet).  Said variance request is being submitted 
under the provisions of §181.93 as modified by recent statutory changes to M.G.L. c.40A §10. 
Located in the Residential C District Map 82 Block 134 Lot 0
